title: I made a gomoku game where getting blocked makes you angry, and anger lets you flip the table
author: SuruiMakesGames
selftext:
Hi! I made Rage Gomoku, a free browser game. It's classic five-in-a-row with one twist: every time your open three or four gets blocked, you gain Rage. Two Rage draws a card, and the cards are dirty tricks: Bomb Stone, Table Flip, Line Thief, Board Split and seven more. They wreck the board, but you still have to finish the line yourself. 

Made by me and Claude Opus 5.5: I designed the game and wrote the story, and the code was written with Claude. The character art, backgrounds and music were made with AI tools. 

I'd love feedback, especially: 

\- Which card feels broken? 

\- If you tried online play, did anything feel laggy or out of sync?

comments.author: deebonz
comments.body: So cool! I’ll give this a go
